[EXPERIMENTAL] Get the details of a Policy Group

## Synopsis

[EXPERIMENTAL] Get the details of a Policy Group.

Retrieves detailed information about a single Policy Group in an
organization, including the list of Policy Packs applied to it, the
stacks or Insights accounts added to the group individually, and the
stack and account match rules, if any. Match rules are shown in the
syntax `pulumi policy group edit --stack-rule` accepts, or as JSON when
that syntax cannot express them.

Pass --stacks or --accounts to list the group's member stacks or Insights
accounts instead: both those added individually and those matched by the
group's match rule. Only members you have permission to read are listed.
--source narrows the list to one of the two. The first 100 members are
shown by default; use --count or --all to fetch more. With --output=json,
hasMore reports whether members were left out.

Each applied Policy Pack shows how many of its policies the group configures;
pass --show-config to list them.

Default output is a human-readable summary; pass --output=json for the
full response as JSON.

```
pulumi policy group get <name> [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  # Show a Policy Group
  pulumi policy group get prod-policies

  # Show a Policy Group with each pack's policy configuration
  pulumi policy group get prod-policies --show-config

  # Show a Policy Group in another organization as JSON
  pulumi policy group get prod-policies --org acme --output json

  # List every stack in a Policy Group, including those matched by its match rule
  pulumi policy group get prod-policies --stacks --all

  # List only the Insights accounts matched by a Policy Group's match rule
  pulumi policy group get compliance --accounts --source rule
```

## Options

```
      --accounts        List the Insights accounts in the group that you can read, added individually or matched by its match rule
      --all             With --stacks or --accounts, return every member you can read; mutually exclusive with --count
      --count int       With --stacks or --accounts, the maximum number of members to return (default 100)
  -h, --help            help for get
      --org string      The organization that owns the Policy Group
      --output string   Output format. Supported values are: default and json (default "default")
      --show-config     List each policy pack's configured policies under the pack
      --source string   With --stacks or --accounts, list only members that were added individually (explicit) or matched by the match rule (rule)
      --stacks          List the stacks in the group that you can read, added individually or matched by its match rule
```
